name: Rudraraju Sai Nikhil Varma
title: Full Stack Developer
tagline: Learning the web one layer at a time - HTML today, MERN by week 12.
about: I am working through a 3-month full stack roadmap. Week 1 is about understanding how the web actually works and writing clean HTML and CSS by hand before any framework gets involved.

projects.title: Personal Bio Page
projects.description: A single page written in pure HTML - headings, links, images, lists and a table. No CSS at all, so the browser's default styles are on full display.

projects.title: Contact Form
projects.description: An accessible contact form built with semantic tags and real labels, plus browser-native validation using required, type and pattern.

projects.title: Styled Bio Page
projects.description: The Tuesday page restyled with CSS variables, a controlled box model, a Flexbox navbar and a responsive card row.

roadmap.focus: How the web works, HTML and CSS basics
